title: Strong attachment keeps the warmth of care

captions.emotions: Feeling the fruits of tangible care

meaning: Retaining familiar action from powerful attachment can emotionally coexist with warmth from care that does not yet mean freedom of choice.
text: The Devil occupies two different positions in this Energy Field. In the physical position, it describes shared actions around attachment, where familiar participation is difficult to stop freely. In energy, the same Devil motivates retaining a compelling bond, where desire intertwines with restricted choice. The Empress in emotions adds warmth from care and tangible fruits of attention. Constricting practice can therefore be supported by a similar motive while bringing real pleasure. A pleasant result does not establish that everyone freely chose the form or that it must continue unchanged.

For example, you prepare another substantial dinner together because missing it brings guilt. Preserving the familiar occasion becomes a motive in itself, even when time is scarce. The finished table, food and the other person’s care bring pleasure. **The warmth of our evening is real, while freedom to choose differently remains a question.** Emotional enjoyment concerns a particular result of attention; it does not remove difficulty in declining that remains beside it for one or both people. Pleasure and restriction can be present together.

A difficulty arises if comfort becomes a final justification for holding on. A changed wish then seems ungrateful, while care binds you more tightly to the earlier form. The Devil’s two roles mean no doubled doom and prove no malicious intention in another person. The Empress does not make comfort evidence of complete agreement. Retained action, its motive and a pleasant emotional response remain different aspects of shared experience, rather than one automatically explaining the others.
